what_is_proven: Nine real-derived nonreconstructive semantic packets can traverse semantic validation, Passage Intelligence and Step-F diagnostics while model hypotheses remain non-authoritative.
Diagnosis is available on all nine routed cases while revision authority remains zero when protected-language/canon authority is absent.

Step 007 can now distinguish a purpose-relative STRENGTH from a neutral OBSERVATION, an abstention, a limitation, a risk, an opportunity and an intentional/protected feature without making strengths revision-eligible.

not_proven: The model-calibration strength labels are not independent human/editor or explicit-author ground truth.

No result authorizes automatic manuscript revision, canon replacement or publication.
